description: Settlement Report Dataset is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Home Affairs. Settlement reports from the Department of Home Affairs, available for download as Excel (XLSX) spreadsheets. These contain datasets and additional metadata and methodological information. The database contains a record of people who have been granted a permanent or provisional visa dating back to January 1991. Data coverage is at the National, State or Territory, Local Government Area (LGA) area. Coverage is Australia, 1991 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
